fields.description: Issue includes extensive election and primary vote totals for Florida and Dade County offices (including governor and local judicial and county races). Features a major editorial on Coral Gables politics and finance surrounding the ousting of George E. Merrick from the city commission, arguing competing banking/bond interests and potential bankruptcy impacts. Additional pieces discuss civic development dreams for Greater Miami, support for an East Coast Canal bond issue election (June 26), local civic and society items, and commentary on prohibition-era liquor prices and local events; includes letters to the editor and advertisements.
